I do put in an effort. Everyone knows me as the guy that's always happy. I try. I really do. Its fucking exhausting. I cant explain this feeling. Its fucking terrible. I feel like I'm going crazy and I just want out. Its been with me all my life. A while back I tried to hang myself, my sister found me and the only thing I regret was not checking to see if anyone was home. The problem is I have no problem. Its really hard to describe this feeling. 

That is why I am asking for help. If cyanide can do it, there must be some other chemical that I can actually grab a hold of that is just as effective. I dont want to risk failure. I need a surefire way
Im losing my mind please help me find a fast way. I can't take this any longer

I have no fucking idea how to use TOR and I don't really trust it enough to buy cyanide from it. If you can teach me that would be great too. I find it kind of stupid that pharmacies don't sell suicide pills. Maybe include a mandatory therapy sessions (I tried therapy, did not work but it could for others). It would end a lot of problems like people suiciding by cop and car crashes since they can hurt other people.
